name: Idaho

jury_list.statute: Idaho Code 2-213(4): 'The contents of any records or papers used by the jury commissioner or the clerk in connection with the selection process and not made public under section 2-206 (5), Idaho Code, shall not be disclosed, except in connection with the preparation or presentation of a motion under subsection (1) of this section.' 2-208(1): 'Neither the names drawn nor the list shall be disclosed to any person except upon specific order of the presiding judge.' 2-208(7): 'The contents of the juror qualification questionnaire form shall be confidential to the extent provided by rules of the Idaho supreme court.'
jury_list.holder: County jury commission / clerk of the district court.

sources.cite: Idaho Code 2-208 (qualification questionnaire asks about citizenship; names drawn not disclosed; contents confidential per court rule)
Idaho Code 2-213(4) (selection records not disclosed except for a jury-selection motion)
Idaho Code 2-206(5) (master and county jury lists open to the public as provided by supreme court rule)

voter_file.who_may_get: Any individual, from the county clerk, at reproduction cost (Idaho Code 34-437(1)). The list holds names and addresses by precinct.
voter_file.permitted_uses: Not for mailing or delivering advertisements, offers, or solicitations for money or anything of value; any political purpose is allowed (34-437(2)).

private_challenge.who: At the time of an election, any registered elector may challenge an entry in the election register by noting the reason and signing (Idaho Code 34-431). The county clerk follows up after the election (34-432). No pre-election written challenge by a private elector was found.
private_challenge.form_or_statute: Idaho Code 34-431, 34-432. Not supported by JuryRoll.

sources.cite: Idaho Code 34-432 (post-election clerk inquiry; clerk may inquire into any registration at any time)

county_board.name: Idaho county clerks (VoteIdaho.gov)
county_board.note: The county clerk must suspend a registration that appears from the clerk's records not to be a citizen's (Idaho Code 34-419).

ag.name: Idaho Office of the Attorney General

audit_path.statute: Idaho Code 74-102 (Public Records Act) and 52 U.S.C. 20507(i) (NVRA public inspection of list-maintenance records)
audit_path.what_you_can_request: Counts only, from the county clerk: per year, the number of registrations suspended or cancelled because the registrant was not a U.S. citizen (Idaho Code 34-419), and the number of election-day 34-431 challenges on citizenship grounds.
audit_path.note: Do not ask for names. No Idaho statute sends juror citizenship answers to election officials. Whether clerks keep counts by reason was not confirmed.

gates.basis: Juror selection records may not be disclosed (Idaho Code 2-213(4), 2-208). The only private challenge is at the time of an election (34-431). Strict gates: counts only.

notes: CHANGED 2026-10-07: applied under Optimus standing rule (no gate loosens). jury_list statute quoted exactly (2-213(4), 2-208(1), 2-208(7)); jury sources 2-213 and 2-206(5); audit_path; federal_source_url moved to govinfo. official_pipeline stays null. No gate changes. No voter_file value changes.

PA-style check: 2-206(5) opens 'The master and county jury lists' to the public 'as provided by supreme court rule'. Those lists show people who may be called, not who was disqualified or why. Hint copy as in REQ-42 (REQ-NOTE 59). The supreme court rule was not read.

official_pipeline is null: no jury-to-clerk non-citizen statute was found. Idaho Code 34-419 tells the county clerk to suspend any registration that appears, from the clerk's own records, not to be a citizen's. The NCSL table (updated Sept. 1, 2026) does not list Idaho.
Cancelled-voter file: no published Idaho cancelled-voter file with a jury reason code was found. REQ-NOTE 27 drops cancelled rows before matching.
dob_in_public_file and registration_date_in_public_file are null: 34-437 lists names and addresses only and does not address other fields.
